stemMd: What is the negation of "Both valves are open"?

options.label: A
options.textMd: At least one valve is open.

options.label: C
options.textMd: At least one valve is not open.

explanationMd: Negating a conjunction gives a disjunction of negations: the first valve is not open or the second is not open, including the case where neither is open.

distractorRationale.b: The issue is the state of the given valves.
distractorRationale.a: This is compatible with both being open.
distractorRationale.d: Both being closed also negates the statement.
distractorRationale.e: One closed valve already negates the statement.
